model_output.verdict: Your product design work at Loop Fitness gives you a clear direction, and the booking flow and design system are real work a recruiter can recognize. I’d hesitate because the resume leaves too much of your part in releases and testing unexplained.
write_up: Your resume points to product design, with app work at Loop Fitness and agency work at Brightpath Studio, followed by your current cafe role. It’s common to list the work this way, but without more about your contributions and what you learned, it may not stand out among other product design resumes.

The strongest model is the Loop Fitness design system: you name what you created, where it was used and the tool. Your current role accounts for the time since your last design job, though a recruiter will notice that your most recent design work ended in February 2024.

Let’s start with the Loop Fitness releases and usability tests. Add your contribution and a finding you can speak to, then bring one Brightpath project into focus. If you’ve done more recent design work, your resume can make room for it too.
